method: Static ASAR source-byte reads, no target code executed. Anchors are analyst observations, not REA graph edges.
observed: Profile active_root_thread_id and room/conversation identifiers are separately consumed.
Room messages POST includes task_id, request_id and idempotency_token.
Send error handling distinguishes rejected, aborted and delivery_unknown; unknown delivery retains same-request retry metadata.
Room live stream validates room/subscription identity and increasing revision, with bounded exponential reconnect delays.
Task subscription obtains topic_id, verifies it before subscribing, and emits resync with 5s retry on failure.
Task transcript renderer handles MCP tool calls, approval review, hooks and artifacts. This proves renderer support, not execution of every item by dots.
User elicitation responses have a separate POST endpoint.
Live room consumer reads turn_status and computer_status; actual computer command execution is untraced.
inferred: The visible architecture separates messaging from task execution records and synchronizes them through subscriptions. Exact server dispatch from a posted message to an agent task remains unresolved.
unknown: Server system prompts, planning loop, model selection, memory selection, scheduling and tool execution policy.
Whether these static paths are enabled or invoked for the current account.
End-to-end runtime request/event ordering and local/cloud computer command transport.
